description: Source code for the DeviceList React functional component, responsible for displaying, deleting, pinging, and refreshing the list of devices in the frontend web application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of devices from the backend API and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the confirmation ID for device deletion.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms device deletion, calls API, updates device list, and manages UI states.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Pings a specific device and updates its status in the state.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Reloads the device list from the backend API.
